questions.text: Who co-chaired the 16th India-Singapore Defence Policy Dialogue (DPD) on May 28, 2026, alongside India's Defence Secretary, Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Mr Joseph Leong

In News

  • The 16th India-Singapore Defence Policy Dialogue (DPD) was held in Singapore on May 28, 2026.

Key Points

  • The dialogue was co-chaired by India's Defence Secretary Shri Rajesh Kumar Singh and Singapore’s Permanent Secretary (Defence) Mr Joseph Leong.
  • The meeting involved a comprehensive review of ongoing defence engagements, military engagements, and defence industry collaboration.
  • The discussions focused on capacity building and regional security issues, aiming to strengthen the strategic relationship between the two nations.
  • Both sides explored expanding cooperation in niche and emerging domains such as cyber security, artificial intelligence (AI), and maritime security.
  • The correct answer is Mr Joseph Leong as he is the designated official who co-led the dialogue from the Singaporean side as per the official release.

Additional Information

  • The Defence Secretary visited the Digital Operations Technology Centre of the Digital and Intelligence Service of the Singapore Armed Forces.
  • This visit aimed to explore the potential for collaboration in niche and emergent domains of warfare.
  • Cooperation within the ADMM-Plus (ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting-Plus) framework and other ASEAN-led mechanisms was also appreciated during the dialogue.

Important Points

  • Both countries reiterated their commitment to an open, inclusive, and rule-based regional security architecture in the Indo-Pacific region.
  • The dialogue underscored the importance of innovation-driven partnerships to address evolving global security challenges.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the Second Employment Working Group (EWG) Meeting under India’s BRICS Presidency 2026:

I. The meeting was held in Hyderabad, Telangana, in May 2026.
II. It was attended by representatives from BRICS Member States, including Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia, and the United Arab Emirates.

Which of the statements given above are correct?

options.text: Only I is correct regarding the city

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Only II

In News

  • The Second Employment Working Group (EWG) Meeting under India’s BRICS Presidency 2026 successfully concluded in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.
  • The gathering advanced discussions on global labour markets, worker welfare, and social security.

Key Points

  • Statement I is incorrect: The Second EWG Meeting under India’s BRICS Presidency 2026 was held in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, from 6–7 May 2026.
  • Statement II is correct: The meeting witnessed participation from a broad spectrum of BRICS Member States dealing with labour and employment. The attendees included Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, along with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia, and the United Arab Emirates.
  • The technical inputs were not provided by the World Bank and IMF. Instead, they were shared by key international knowledge partners including the International Labour Organization (ILO), the International Social Security Association (ISSA), and the United Nations Resident Coordinator Office.

Additional Information

  • The overarching discussions were structured across four priority themes: Social Protection, Gender Inclusion, Skills and Employability, and Digital Integration.
  • The dialogue prioritized leveraging digital public infrastructure, supporting women's employment, improving digital skilling, and extending services to gig and platform workers.

Important Points

  • This Second Meeting built upon the foundations laid during the First EWG Meeting held in March 2026.
  • The deliverables are expected to be finalized in the upcoming Third EWG Meeting and will be adopted at the BRICS Labour and Employment Ministers’ Meeting scheduled for July 2026.

questions.text: Which portal has been developed to provide a single-window clearance system for live event permissions according to the 4th Live Events Development Cell meeting?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is India Cine Hub (ICH) portal

In News

  • The Ministry of Information & Broadcasting (MIB) hosted the 4th meeting of the Live Events Development Cell (LEDC) to review the roadmap to position India as a global hub for live events.
  • During the meeting, it was announced that a single-window clearance system has been developed on the India Cine Hub (ICH) portal.

Key Points

  • Single-Window Clearance: To ensure faster, transparent, and efficient approvals for live events, a single-window clearance system was explicitly developed on the India Cine Hub (ICH) portal.
  • Adoption by States: The adoption of the ICH portal by various states and Union Territories will facilitate the digitization of the live event permissions process, streamlining operations across the country.
  • This initiative serves the broader aim of the Live Events Development Cell (LEDC) to promote ease of doing business in the media and entertainment sector by minimizing bureaucratic delays.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is the India Cine Hub (ICH) portal, as stated in the news content. The other options are fabricated portals not mentioned in the official statement.

Additional Information

  • Live Events Development Cell (LEDC): Set up in July 2025 under the chairpersonship of the Secretary, MIB, to make India a global hub for live events by 2030.
  • Economic Projections: The organised live events sector is valued at ₹145 billion in 2025 and is projected to grow at 10% to ₹196 billion by 2028. The LEDC aims to generate 15-20 million additional jobs.
  • Model Executive Order: States and UTs have been actively urged to adopt the "Model Executive Order for Streamlining Licensing and Permissions for Live Events in India, 2026" by the target date of 31st May 2026.
  • Skilling Initiatives: The Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), in collaboration with MESC and EEMA, is set to introduce certificate courses to skill professionals in live events.

Important Points

  • The 4th LEDC meeting was held on 30th April 2026 at Vigyan Bhavan, New Delhi.
  • The meeting was chaired by Shri Chanchal Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB).
  • The live events sector has emerged as the highest growth segment within the Indian Media and Entertainment industry.

questions.text:
Consider the following statements regarding the LIC’s New Jeevan Sathi joint life insurance savings plans launched in May 2026:

  1. Both Single Premium and Limited Premium versions are non-par and non-market linked plans.
  2. The Single Premium plan offers guaranteed additions at the rate of Rs 70 for every Rs 1,000 basic sum assured.
  3. The Limited Premium plan provides a premium waiver on the first death during the premium paying term.
  4. These plans entitle policyholders to discretionary benefits like bonuses or a share in surplus.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1, 2, and 3

In News

  • Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) has launched two new joint life insurance savings plans: LIC’s New Jeevan Sathi Single Premium and LIC’s New Jeevan Sathi Limited Premium.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: Both plans are non-par (non-participating), non-market linked, individual life savings plans designed for couples.
  • Statement 2 is correct: For the Single Premium plan, guaranteed additions are provided throughout the policy duration at the rate of Rs 70 per Rs 1,000 basic sum assured.
  • Statement 3 is correct: The Limited Premium plan includes a specific benefit where the premium is waived on the first death occurring during the premium paying term.
  • Statement 4 is incorrect: As these are non-par products, the benefits payable on death or survival are guaranteed and fixed. The news explicitly states that the policy is not entitled to any discretionary benefits like bonus or share in surplus.

Additional Information

  • In the Limited Premium plan, guaranteed additions are provided at the rate of 7% of the total tabular annual premium.
  • Both plans offer flexibility to choose risk cover from two Death Benefit Options.
  • Liquidity needs are addressed through loan facilities available under both plans.

Important Points

  • The plans offer coverage for a married person and their spouse under a single policy.
  • Policyholders have the option to enhance coverage by opting for rider benefits on payment of additional premiums.

questions.text: What is the target year set by the Government of India to realize the vision of ‘Housing for All’ under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G) as per the recent announcement by the Ministry of Rural Development?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is March 2029

In News

  • Union Minister for Rural Development Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan released a Mother Sanction of ₹10,021.42 crore to 12 States under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G).

Key Points

  • The vision for ‘Housing for All’ is targeted to be achieved by March 2029.
  • The PMAY-G scheme was launched in 2016 with the goal of ensuring no poor person lives in a kutcha house.
  • Against a total target of 4.95 crore houses, approvals for 3.91 crore houses have been granted.
  • To date, the construction of more than 3.05 crore houses has been successfully completed under the scheme.
  • The 12 states receiving the sanction include Assam, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Karnataka, Kerala, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh.

Additional Information

  • Nearly 75 per cent of the houses sanctioned under PMAY-G are in the name of women or under joint ownership, promoting women's empowerment.
  • The government is focusing on convergence with other welfare schemes to provide amenities like roads, electricity, drinking water, LPG connections, and toilets.
  • A prior Mother Sanction of ₹11,121 crore was already released for the financial year 2026-27.

Important Points

  • The Union Minister urged states to complete house approvals for the 2024-25 and 2025-26 cycles by 30 June 2026.
  • Beneficiaries were encouraged to plant a sapling under the ‘Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam’ campaign on World Environment Day (5 June 2026).
  • The housing target for the current year is three times higher than the previous year.

questions.text: With which organization did the Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in May 2026 to establish 'Smart Digital Classrooms'?
questions.explanation:

Key Points

  • The primary objective of the MoU is to establish 'Smart Digital Classrooms' in schools located around SAIL’s operational areas.
  • This initiative is part of SAIL’s Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) activities to enhance learning outcomes and promote inclusive education.
  • The project aligns with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal - 4 (SDG-4).
  • The MoU was signed in the presence of Shri K. K. Singh, Director (Personnel), SAIL, along with other senior officials from both organizations.

Additional Information

questions.text:
With reference to the 12th round of India-Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IK CEPA) upgrade negotiations, consider the following statements:

  1. The negotiations were held in New Delhi from 25 to 27 May 2026.
  2. The original IK CEPA came into force in the year 2010.
  3. Both countries decided to constitute sub-groups to discuss cooperation in digital trade and supply chain cooperation.
  4. The 12th round of negotiations was co-chaired by Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 1, 2, and 3

In News

  • The 12th round of India-Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IK CEPA) upgrade negotiations was held in New Delhi from 25–27 May 2026.

Key Points

  • Statement 1 is correct: The 12th round of negotiations took place in New Delhi from 25 to 27 May 2026 following a joint declaration signed in April 2026.
  • Statement 2 is correct: The news content explicitly mentions that the IK CEPA came into force in 2010, and both sides acknowledged the rising bilateral trade deficit since that time.
  • Statement 3 is correct: During the round, it was decided to constitute sub-groups to expand talks on digital trade, supply chain cooperation, and strategic industrial cooperation.
  • Statement 4 is incorrect: The 12th round of negotiations was co-chaired by Ms. Kapil Chaudhary (Joint Secretary, Department of Commerce, India) and Mr. Park Geun-oh (Director General for Trade Agreement Policy, South Korea). Shri Piyush Goyal and Mr. Yeo Han-koo signed the Joint Declaration in April 2026, but they did not co-chair this specific 12th round session.

Additional Information

  • The negotiations focused on several chapters including Trade in Goods (TiG), Trade in Services (TiS), Rules of Origin (RoO), and Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) standards.
  • The partnership is envisioned as a "Futuristic Partnership" by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and President Mr. Lee Jae-myung.

Important Points

  • The primary objective of the upgrade is to achieve a modernised and mutually beneficial agreement that addresses the trade deficit and supports balanced bilateral trade.
  • The talks reflect the commitment to a future-oriented trade partnership between India and the Republic of Korea.

questions.text: While making nomination, signature of nominee is required on
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is None of these.

  • The Nomination Rules in respect of Deposit Accounts provide as under: The nomination to be made by the depositor or, as the case may be, all the depositors together in respect of a deposit held by a co-operative bank to the credit of one or more individuals.
  • A Nominee is a person whom you can list in your investment or bank application as the person who can receive the proceeds of your account in case of your unexpected death. The nominee can be anyone you deem to be your first relative - your parents, spouse, kids, siblings etc.
  • A nomination in banking terms refers to an account holder's right to appoint one or more persons who are entitled to receive the money in case of the death of the account holder.
  • The nominee is authorised to withdraw all the amount that had been left in the account of deceased. However the other legal heirs can make a claim to the bank for this if the nominee is not ready to share the amount among the legal heirs.

questions.text: Who has been appointed as the Executive Director of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) with effect from May 18, 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Gunveer Singh

In News

  • On May 18, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) announced the appointment of Gunveer Singh as Executive Director.

Key Points

  • Gunveer Singh has been elevated to the post of Executive Director at the RBI.
  • Prior to this promotion, he was serving as the Chief General Manager-in-Charge of the Department of Payment and Settlement Systems.
  • In his new role, he will continue to oversee the Department of Payment and Settlement Systems, which regulates India's payments infrastructure.
  • He is a qualified Chartered Accountant and Cost and Works Accountant.
  • Manish Yadav and Surendra Kumar Jha were appointed to the Ministry of Heavy Industries and BSF respectively, not the RBI. Ravi Shanker was empanelled but not yet appointed as the Executive Director in the specific announcement on May 18.

Additional Information

  • The RBI empanelled five senior officers for Executive Director posts, including Monisha Chakraborty, Suman Ray, Sudhakar Malli, and Ravi Shanker.
  • Manish Yadav, a 2016-batch IRS officer, was appointed as Deputy Secretary in the Ministry of Heavy Industries for a four-year tenure.
  • Surendra Kumar Jha was appointed as Deputy Inspector General (DIG) in the Border Security Force (BSF).

Important Points

  • The appointments reflect the government's focus on placing experienced professionals in regulatory and security roles.
  • Gunveer Singh brings extensive expertise in banking regulation and financial systems to his new role.

questions.text: Which city has been approved by FIFA to serve as the relocated training base camp for the Iranian national team during the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Tijuana

In News

  • FIFA has officially approved the request from the Football Federation Islamic Republic of Iran to move its 2026 World Cup base camp from the United States to Mexico.

Key Points

  • Relocation Details: The Iranian team will now be based in Tijuana, Mexico, instead of their originally planned location in Tucson, Arizona.
  • Reason for Shift: The move was motivated by geopolitical sensitivities, visa procedures, and travel logistics. Iranian officials believe a Mexican base will simplify entry processes for players and staff.
  • Strategic Location: Tijuana was chosen due to its proximity to the US border and San Diego, providing easy access to California, where Iran will play two of its group matches.
  • Matches in USA: Despite the base camp shift, Iran will still play all its Group G fixtures in the United States, specifically at SoFi Stadium (Inglewood) and Lumen Field (Seattle).
  • Other Options: Tucson was the original planned base; Istanbul was the location where discussions with FIFA took place; San Diego is a nearby US city but not the site of the base camp.

Additional Information

  • The 2026 FIFA World Cup will be jointly hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico from June 11 to July 19.
  • Team Melli (Iran) is making its fourth consecutive and seventh overall appearance in the World Cup.
  • Iran's group stage opponents include New Zealand, Belgium, and Egypt.

Important Points

  • The decision was confirmed by Mehdi Taj, the chief of the Iranian football federation, following meetings with the FIFA Secretary General.
  • The Tijuana base is fully equipped with training facilities, a gym, and a private restaurant dedicated to the team.

questions.text: To what percentage has US-based Liberty Mutual Insurance increased its shareholding in its Indian arm, Liberty General Insurance Limited (LGI)?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 74 per cent

In News

  • US-based Liberty Mutual Insurance has announced an increase in its stake in its Indian venture, Liberty General Insurance Limited (LGI), to 74 per cent.

Key Points

  • Liberty Mutual Insurance increased its shareholding from a previous level of 55.40 per cent to 74 per cent in May 2026.
  • The company had earlier raised its stake from 49 per cent to 55.40 per cent in September 2025.
  • This strategic move follows the Indian government's policy change in December 2025, which allowed up to 100 per cent foreign direct investment (FDI) in the insurance sector.
  • The increased backing is intended to help Liberty General Insurance expand its distribution footprint and strengthen its presence in both retail and commercial line segments.
  • Parag Ved, the CEO and Whole-Time Director of Liberty General Insurance, highlighted that the focus remains on advancing insurance penetration in India.

Additional Information

  • Liberty Mutual Insurance Group is a major global player, ranked 91st among Fortune 500 companies.
  • It is the 9th-largest property and casualty (P&C) insurer globally.
  • As of 2025, the group held USD 178.2 billion in assets and reported USD 50.5 billion in revenue.
  • Matthew Jackson serves as the President of Liberty International Insurance APAC.

Important Points

  • The 74 per cent stake represents Liberty Mutual's deepening commitment to the fast-growing Indian insurance market.
  • The development underscores the impact of liberalized FDI norms in the Indian financial services landscape.

questions.text: Which fintech company recently received in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a Payment Aggregator-Physical (PA-P) licence to expand into offline merchant payments?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is One Mobikwik Systems

In News

  • One Mobikwik Systems, the parent company of Mobikwik, has secured in-principle approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a Payment Aggregator-Physical (PA-P) licence.

Key Points

  • PA-P Licence Approval: The RBI's in-principle approval allows Mobikwik to facilitate offline merchant payments across India. This move is aimed at strengthening the company's presence in the physical payment space.
  • Strategic Growth: According to CEO Bipin Preet Singh, this approval sets the company up for 10x growth in its merchant business by FY28.
  • Under-penetrated Markets: The company plans to leverage this licence to scale merchant payments infrastructure, particularly in under-penetrated markets beyond urban India.
  • Offline Advantage: Mobikwik highlighted that offline acquiring offers better Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) opportunities, subscriptions, and device rental economics compared to consumer payments.
  • Recent Licences: This approval follows the company securing a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) licence from the RBI just a month prior.

Additional Information

  • Current Reach: Mobikwik currently supports approximately 4.9 million merchants through UPI QR codes, soundboxes, and EDC (card payment) machines as a technology enabler.
  • Financial Performance: For Q4 FY26, Mobikwik reported a net profit of Rs 4.38 crore, a significant turnaround from a net loss of Rs 56 crore in the same period the previous year.
  • Market Opportunity: Consulting firm Redseer estimates the Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) of the merchant payments opportunity to be $1.8-2 trillion by FY28.

Important Points

  • One Mobikwik Systems is the entity that received the PA-P licence.
  • The company's revenue from operations rose 8% on-year to Rs 289 crore in Q4 FY26.
  • The expansion focus for the next 18-24 months includes small businesses, organised retail, and fuel outlets.

questions.text: Who was the first chairman of the Competition Commission of India (CCI) who recently passed away following a fire incident at his residence in Delhi?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Dhanendra Kumar

In News

  • Dhanendra Kumar, a former bureaucrat and the first chairman of the Competition Commission of India (CCI), passed away after a fire broke out at his residence in Hauz Khas, South Delhi.

Key Points

  • Dhanendra Kumar was a distinguished 1968-batch IAS officer of the Haryana cadre.
  • He served as the first chairman of the Competition Commission of India (CCI), playing a pivotal role in the organization's early years.
  • The incident occurred at his Hauz Khas Enclave residence, where a fire, suspected to have been caused by an air-conditioner (AC) unit blast, led to his death due to smoke inhalation.
  • The blaze was reported to the Delhi Fire Services at 11:24 pm and was brought under control by 12:20 am.
  • While Kumar succumbed to his injuries during treatment at the AIIMS Trauma Centre, his son sustained injuries but is reported to be out of danger.

Additional Information

  • Beyond his role at the CCI, Kumar represented India as an Executive Director at the World Bank.
  • He also held significant administrative positions including Chairman and Managing Director of the Haryana State Industrial Development Corporation (HSIDC).
  • He served as the Principal Secretary to the Haryana Chief Minister during his administrative career.
  • He was recognized as an author and a public policy expert in his post-bureaucratic life.

Important Points

  • A crime team and electrical inspectors are investigating the exact cause, though no foul play is currently suspected.
  • The fire affected domestic articles on the ground floor and wooden structures on the first floor of the building.

questions.text: According to the notification issued by the Ministry of Finance, what is the rate of duty prescribed for the export of diesel for the fortnight starting 1st June, 2026?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is Rs 13.5 per litre

In News

  • The Ministry of Finance has notified the revised export levies on petrol, diesel, and aviation turbine fuel (ATF) for the fortnight beginning 1st June, 2026.

Key Points

  • Diesel Export Duty: The rate of duty for the export of diesel is notified as Rs 13.5 per litre. This comprises a Special Additional Excise Duty (SAED) of Rs 13.5 and a Road and Infrastructure Cess (RIC) of Nil.
  • Petrol Export Duty: The duty for petrol exports is set at Rs 1.5 per litre (SAED- Rs 1.5; RIC- Nil).
  • ATF Export Duty: The duty for Aviation Turbine Fuel is set at Rs 9.5 per litre (SAED only).
  • The government clarified that there is no change in the existing excise duty rates on petrol and diesel cleared for domestic consumption.

Additional Information

  • These export levies were originally introduced on 27th March, 2026, to ensure the availability of petroleum products within India.
  • The move was a response to the West Asia crises, aimed at disincentivising exports to protect the domestic supply chain.
  • The previous revision of these rates was undertaken with effect from 16th May, 2026.

Important Points

  • The levies are revised on a fortnightly basis to align with the average international prices of crude oil and refined products.
  • The objective of such duties is to manage the domestic energy security by controlling the outflow of essential fuels.
